description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer deferred-main resize checkpoint: safe Rust owns the pending main-buffer resize lifecycle while an alternate buffer is active, including DECSET 1049 re-entry before the resize is materialized.

entries.notes: Safe Rust verifies both Microsoft data rows: resizing the active alternate to 60x24 leaves the main buffer/view unchanged until release; optional DECSET 1049 re-entry replaces the logical alternate without losing the pending size; returning to main then materializes the deferred resize.
